newsitem.title: USA: General American sets special dividend.
newsitem.headline: General American sets special dividend.

text.p: General American Investors Co Inc Wednesday declared "spill-over" dividends on its stock for 1996, including a $0.44-per-share capital gains dividend, payable March 12, 1997 to stockholders of record Jan 27, 1997.
The capital gains dividend is from net long-term profit on securities sold during from Nov 1, 1996 through Dec 31, 1996.
The company also set an income dividend of $0.06 a share representing the balance of the distribution for 1996 from accumulated undistributed income and short-term capital gains.
The payout brings to $0.25 per share the total amount of dividends paid from ordinary income, including $0.05 per share from 1996 short-term capital gains.

Shareholders may elect to receive the capital gains dividend and the income dividend as additional shares of the company's common stock for the combined total dividends of $0.50 per share, or receive cash for both dividends, they said.
